security.pageSubtitle: Two-factor authentication, email verification, devices and the audit trail.
security.mfaDescription: Use an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password and similar) for a 6-digit code at sign-in and before sensitive actions.
security.mfaScan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key manually.
security.mfaRecoveryHelp: Each code works once if you lose your authenticator. Store them somewhere safe: they are shown only now.
security.mfaDisableHelp: Enter your password and a current code (or a recovery code) to turn two-factor authentication off.
security.mfaRequiredBy: A company you belong to requires two-factor authentication. Set it up to keep access.
security.stepUpHelp: This action needs a fresh two-factor check. Enter the current code.
security.emailSent: Verification link sent. Check your inbox.
security.emailQueued: The link is queued but email is not configured on this server yet.
security.emailGrace: Until {date} you can use everything. After that, issuing documents and inviting people needs a verified address.
security.emailRestricted: Issuing documents and inviting people is paused until you verify your email address.
security.emailNotEnforced: Email verification is not enforced on this server (no email provider configured or the setting is off).
security.policyHelp: Require two-factor authentication for members of this company. Members covered by the policy cannot open the company until they set it up.
security.policyEnrolFirst: Turn on two-factor authentication for your own account first.
security.auditHelp: Every security event, posting and account change is recorded in an append-only log whose entries are linked by SHA-256 hashes, so an edit or deletion inside the database is detectable.
security.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
security.loginMfaHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
security.verifyEmailFailed: This verification link is invalid or has expired. Sign in and request a new one from Security settings.
security.registerCheckEmail: Check your email to confirm your address. If you already have an account, sign in instead.
